title: Auto-update on by default with health-gated rollback
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Release sync is enabled at install, checks hourly, and rolls back on a failed health check; opt out with one command. Tests zc_updates_default_*.
